title: How Long Is GTA 6? Story Length, Real Finish Times and 100% (No Spoilers)
h1: How long is GTA 6? The real hours
desc: How long to beat GTA 6: reviewers took 50-70 hours, Rockstar's own run took about 80, IShowSpeed finished in 52 h 31 min. GTA 5 comparison, 100% estimates, no spoilers.
lede: Short answer: most players should expect 50 to 70 hours for GTA 6's story, about double GTA 5. Below is every finish time we could check from reviewers, Rockstar and the first streamers, in one table. No story spoilers.

Rob Nelson, co-head of Rockstar North, said his playthrough took about 80 hours. That run included optional goals, so treat it as story plus some extras, not a story-only time.
Why GTA 6 is close to double GTA 5

GTA 5's main story takes about 32 hours on HowLongToBeat. Most GTA 6 reviewers landed between 50 and 70. Early HowLongToBeat entries for GTA 6 show 42 hours, but from only a handful of submissions, so expect that number to move.

Our take: the reviewers who took longest are the ones who explored Leonida, and that's the better way to play it. There's no prize for rushing a single-player game.
The save lesson from IShowSpeed's 52-hour run

Speed finished in one 52-hour, 31-minute stream. Around hour 43 the game crashed and he went back to an 88% save. After the credits he overwrote his 98% save by accident ("my brain deleted it"). GTA 6 has no mission replay and guides report 15 manual save slots: rotate between a few of them instead of saving over one.

GTA 6 has no difficulty menu, but two toggles at the bottom of Settings > Gameplay work like an easy mode: Accessible Combat (enemies have less health and deal less damage) and Reduced Vehicle Damage. Reports say trophies still unlock, and you can switch them off anytime.
note: All times are as reported by the outlets and streamers listed below; HowLongToBeat numbers are early and based on few players.
faq: Most reviewers finished it in about 50 to 70 hours. Rockstar North's Rob Nelson said his playthrough, with optional goals, took about 80 hours.
How long is GTA 6 compared to GTA 5?
GTA 5's main story is about 32 hours on HowLongToBeat, so GTA 6 is close to double for most players.
New Zealand streamer BrycexD reportedly finished in about 39.5 hours thanks to the earlier time zone. IShowSpeed finished in 52 hours 31 minutes in one stream.
